mapper.insert: INSERT INTO command_dedup (user_id, command_type, request_key, request_hash, result_type, result_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{commandType}, #{requestKey}, #{requestHash}, #{resultType}, #{resultId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, command_type, request_key, request_hash, result_type, result_id, created_at FROM command_dedup WHERE created_at < #{before} ORDER BY id LIMIT 500
